result.firstImpression: A big beige banner and a mug, but I had to scroll to even find the price.
result.quote: $38 for one mug plus mystery shipping? I can get a cute mug at Target for twelve bucks.

frictions.issue: $38.00 with 'Shipping calculated at checkout', so I have no idea what the real total is.
No discount code or free shipping threshold anywhere; the newsletter popup only promises 'updates, news and more'.
'Please create an account to complete checkout'. I'm not making an account for one mug.

result.wouldConvince: Show the total with shipping up front, or free shipping over a small amount.

result.firstImpression: Never heard of Hearth & Kiln, and the first thing I see is 'Welcome to our shop!!'
result.quote: No reviews, no address, no phone number, no return policy. I'm not typing my card into this.

frictions.issue: 'No reviews yet' on the product, so nobody has vouched for this store.
The footer only says '© Hearth & Kiln'. No address, phone, email or About page.
No return policy or secure-checkout information anywhere near the Add button.

result.wouldConvince: Real customer reviews plus a visible phone number and return policy.

result.firstImpression: A huge banner saying 'Simple. Beautiful. Ours.' tells me nothing about what I'm buying.
result.quote: I scrolled past a banner, then a popup jumped up, and I still don't know when it would arrive. Closing this.

frictions.issue: The top of the page is a generic 'New Collection' banner; the product, price and button are below the fold.
No delivery estimate anywhere.
The newsletter popup covers part of the product area as soon as the page loads.

result.wouldConvince: Product, price, delivery date and a big buy button visible the moment the page loads.

result.firstImpression: The speckled glaze looks nice, but there's only one real image.
result.quote: 'Our mugs are great' isn't a spec. Is it dishwasher safe? How tall is it? What's it made of?

frictions.issue: The description is three generic sentences, with no dimensions, material or care instructions.
Only one product image; the two thumbnails are empty gray boxes.
No reviews to confirm the quality in person.

result.wouldConvince: A specs list (size, stoneware, microwave and dishwasher safe, lead-free glaze) and more photos.

result.firstImpression: Pretty mug, and it could make a nice gift for my sister.
result.quote: There's no delivery date and no returns info. If it doesn't arrive by her birthday, it's useless to me.

frictions.issue: No shipping speed or delivery date estimate.
I can't find a return or exchange policy in case she doesn't like it.
No gift wrapping or gift note option.

result.wouldConvince: 'Order today, arrives by ___' plus easy returns and a gift note option.

result.firstImpression: It feels handmade and small-batch, which I like.
result.quote: 'Each one is a little different', so who makes them? I want the story before I pay $38.

frictions.issue: Nothing about the maker, the studio or the materials, so the handmade angle is wasted.
There's a 'Blog' link but no About or Our Story page.
No information about packaging or sustainability.

result.wouldConvince: A short 'Made by…' section with the potter's story and where the clay comes from.

result.firstImpression: Okay, a mug. I could get one delivered tomorrow on Amazon.
result.quote: Shipping unknown, no Apple Pay, and I have to create an account? Nope, back to Amazon.

frictions.issue: You have to create an account to check out.
No mention of shipping speed or free shipping.
No express checkout (Shop Pay, Apple Pay or PayPal).

result.wouldConvince: Guest checkout with Apple Pay and fast free shipping.

result.firstImpression: The price and text are small and very light gray, so I had to lean in to read them.
result.quote: I can barely read the price, and a box popped up that I don't know how to close. I'll ask my grandson later.

frictions.issue: The price and key details are in small, low-contrast gray text.
The 'ADD' button is pale gray and doesn't look clickable.
No phone number to call with questions.

result.wouldConvince: Bigger, darker text, a clear 'Add to cart' button and a phone number.

summary.headline: Shoppers find no reason to trust or buy: the price, shipping and reviews are hidden or missing, and checkout demands an account.
strengths: Attractive handmade product with a distinctive speckled glaze

fixes.title: Add reviews and visible trust details
fixes.problem: Robert, Grace and Jordan found no reviews, contact details or return policy, and 'No reviews yet' actively hurts.
fixes.suggestion: Import past customer reviews (even 5–10 from markets or Etsy) and add under the price: '★ 4.9 from 120+ happy customers · Free 30-day returns · Questions? Call (503) 555-0142'.

fixes.title: Show total cost and delivery date upfront
fixes.problem: Maya, Linda, Carlos and Priya left over 'Shipping calculated at checkout' and the lack of any delivery estimate.
fixes.suggestion: Replace the shipping line with: 'Free shipping on 2+ mugs · Order today, arrives by Mon, Nov 10'.

fixes.title: Allow guest checkout with express pay
fixes.problem: 'Please create an account to complete checkout' is a deal breaker for Carlos and Maya.
fixes.suggestion: Turn on guest checkout plus Shop Pay and Apple Pay, remove the account note, and add '🔒 Secure checkout, no account needed' under the button.

fixes.title: Put the product above the fold
fixes.problem: The 'Simple. Beautiful. Ours.' banner pushes the photo, price and button below the first screen.
fixes.suggestion: Remove the hero banner on product pages so the photo, price and a large dark 'Add to cart · $38' button appear immediately.

fixes.title: Replace the description with specifics and a story
fixes.problem: 'Our mugs are great' answers none of Jordan's or Sam's questions.
fixes.suggestion: Lead with 'Hand-thrown speckled stoneware mug, 12 oz', add bullets (4.2" tall · microwave & dishwasher safe · lead-free glaze), then: 'Made by Ana in our 2-person Portland studio.'

fixes.title: Make text readable and delay the popup
fixes.problem: Low-contrast gray text and an instant newsletter popup confused Grace and annoyed Priya.
fixes.suggestion: Use dark text at 16px or larger for the price and description, and show the popup only after 30 seconds or on exit, offering '10% off your first order'.
